request.subject: CITY:DINOSAUR:2

layers.text: Recolour only the orange-ochre hide of the tents: it becomes a dull sandy brown hide, colour #a67c3d with #6e4f26 shadows, not orange and not yellow; its dark brown spots stay. Add nothing: no rocks, no ground and no shadow under the fence. Do not redraw anything. Keep the orange feathers on the tent tips, the bone totem, the bare pole, the fence, the two standing stones, each shape and place, the size, black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
